messages:
maria: Quick check — I pushed a new conversion for atlas-30b to gs://redwood-models/atlas-30b/2026-03-15/
weights/ are safetensors, 8 shards: atlas-30b.safetensors.000 .. .007
config.json is present but tokenizer.json shows merges that might differ from hf release. Anyone validate shard ordering vs TP layout? :eyes:

ben: grabbing the files now. If TP=8 we need shard index to map to tensor-parallel dim 0..7. Common bug: converters sometimes tile across first dim instead of last.

cj: quick sanity: loaded shard 0 shapes look like (4096, 12288) for qkv? Which axis is split?

ben: I ran a quick inspect — q_proj in shard.000 has shape (4096,1536) while shard.001 has (4096,1536) etc. Looks like weights split on output dim across shards (expected). But KV cache ordering seems reversed in tokenizer tests.

maria: tokenizer-ci ran and flagged 5 mismatches for hyphen tokens -> splitting. tokenizer.json shows "add_prefix_space": true on our file but upstream is false. That would shift merge indices. Sam, did conversion include tokenizer normalization step?

sam: I ran the HF convert script but used --legacy-tokenizer flag by accident, so we likely changed prefix behavior. I'll re-run without legacy flag and re-generate tokenizer.json.

devops-bot: ci/check-artifacts for atlas-30b: artifacts found, safetensors checksum ok, shards=8, dtype=fp16 (cast done). CI note: no bf16 variant present.

cj: fp16 is fine but FYI we prefer bf16 for Dedicated GPUs if available. Also need to confirm quantization dims (row vs col) used by runtime when packing kernels.

ben: small diff check snippet I used to compare shard orders:
```
import torch
sh0 = torch.load('atlas-30b.safetensors.000', map_location='cpu')['model.weight']
sh1 = torch.load('atlas-30b.safetensors.001', map_location='cpu')['model.weight']
print(sh0.shape, sh1.shape)
```
If shapes line up on the same split axis we are good.

maria: Action items:
- @sam re-run tokenizer conversion without --legacy and re-upload (by EOD)
- @ben add a small script to validate shard->TP index mapping in repo tools/inspect_shards.py
- @cj create small document about expected split axis conventions for TP/TP-shard naming (prefer last dim split) and include runtime expectations

ben: I'll open the PR for inspect_shards.py now. Short test will assert concatenation(shards, axis=1) == original_matrix.

sam: re-uploading tokenizer now, will paste link once done.

tokenizer-ci: tokenizer validation: 0 mismatches after new tokenizer.json; merges and prefix flags match upstream. :tada:

maria: great. Once ben's script lands we'll run full pack and a smoke serve on staging. If all green we cut a conversion tag. Thanks all :shipit:
